story_beats.speech: Pip the mouse insists the book must stay flat on the ice, but Finn the fox wants to lift it up against the wind.
story_beats.label: Initial Dispute
story_beats.visual_prompt: Pip the mouse stands in a sparkling snowfield beside a heavy leather-bound book, pointing a tiny paw downward with an argumentative expression.

story_beats.headline: Competing Interpretations of Page Protection
story_beats.speech: Finn the fox argues that raising the cover protects the delicate paper from melting frost, while Pip fears a sudden gust.
story_beats.label: The Alternative View
story_beats.visual_prompt: Finn the fox stands in the open snowfield holding one edge of the book with his snout, looking cautiously down at the fluttering pages.

story_beats.headline: Testing the Shared Solution
story_beats.speech: Finn the fox decides to gently lower the book flat onto the packed snow so both animals can examine the text equally.
story_beats.label: The Decisive Test
story_beats.visual_prompt: Finn the fox lowers the heavy book flat onto the snowfield surface with his nose, pressing gently to keep the pages steady and unbent.

story_beats.headline: Harmonious Reading Under the Stars
story_beats.speech: Pip the mouse turns the page softly while Finn the fox rests his chin nearby, proving that cooperation brings warmth to winter.
story_beats.label: Shared Resolution
story_beats.visual_prompt: Pip the mouse sits close to the flat book in the snowfield, turning a paper page with tiny paws while Finn the fox watches happily.

proposal.central_conflict: Pip the mouse wants to read the shared book by resting it flat on the snow, while Finn the fox wants to lift it up to block the biting wind.
proposal.decisive_choice: Finn the fox decides to gently place the shared book flat between them on the snowfield ice so both can view the pages without tearing the spine.
proposal.resolution: Pip the mouse happily turns each page one by one, allowing both animals to enjoy the story together in the snowfield.
